# Excluded from the REQUIRED `required-tests` gate: these files hold ~90%
# of its wall clock. They still run in `heavy-tests`, against the same
# quarantine ledger — on a best-effort SCHEDULE (a few times a day), NOT
# "on every main push". Merges performed by auto-merge raise no push event,
# so the push trigger alone left these files with no coverage at all. See the
# `schedule:` comment in .github/workflows/tests.yml.
#
# WHY a subset gates merges: `strict` branch protection requires a PR to be
# up to date at merge time. main takes a commit every ~10 min (median, 39
# gaps measured 2026-08-03), so a required check must finish inside that
# window. At the full suite's ~37 min only 5% of gaps are long enough to
# land anything; at ~4 min, 79% are.
#
# Excluding these is SAFE, and that was verified rather than assumed: every
# failure the exclusion run reported was also failing in the same-tree full
# run, so the exclusion introduced none. Do not re-derive that claim from a
# run on a different tree — that mistake nearly quarantined 144 real
# regressions as flaky.
#
# Measured: every file whose tests totalled >3.0s in CI run 30780762657
# (12991 tests / 34.0 min). Regenerate after a big suite change.
